entries.applicability_note: Every bidder must hold an active GST registration.
entries.demo_note: Demo bidders carry fictional GSTINs matched against mock GSTN fixtures.
entries.description: Active GST registration certificate in the state of supply; status verified with the GSTN portal.

entries.applicability_note: Every bidder must hold a valid PAN.
entries.demo_note: Nova's mock PAN_IT record carries a different legal name, producing the intended verification MISMATCH.
entries.description: Permanent Account Number in the bidder entity name; active taxpayer status verified with the PAN_IT portal.

entries.applicability_note: Financial soundness check for every bidder.
entries.demo_note: Verification-backed: no evidence document is needed. A bidder with no PAN_IT check evaluates to MISSING (never an assumed pass).
entries.description: Income tax return filed for the latest assessment year, read from the PAN_IT portal record.
entries.requirement_name: Income Tax Return Filing (Latest Assessment Year)
entries.threshold: ITR filed for the latest assessment year

entries.applicability_note: Only evaluated when the bidder claims MSE benefit (EMD exemption / purchase preference).
entries.demo_note: Non-mandatory: bidders without Udyam evaluate to REVIEW_REQUIRED (factor 0.5), never FAIL.
entries.description: Valid Udyam Registration Certificate for micro/small enterprise benefits under the Public Procurement Policy.
entries.policy_reference: Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order 2012

entries.applicability_note: Every incorporated bidder must have an active CIN.
entries.demo_note: Portal-only verification: no evidence document is generated. Mock MCA21 fixtures cover all demo profiles.
entries.description: Corporate Identity Number active on the MCA21 registry; company identity verified against the portal record.

entries.applicability_note: Financial capacity check for every bidder.
entries.demo_note: Demo evidence carries a 1.5x margin over the threshold. Vertex is the only profile without turnover evidence.
entries.description: Average annual financial turnover during the last 3 consecutive financial years must meet the required threshold.

entries.applicability_note: Technical capacity check for every bidder.
entries.demo_note: Demo evidence carries threshold + 2 years. Vertex is the only profile with experience evidence among its missing-evidence set.
entries.description: Satisfactory completion of similar supply or execution contracts with PSUs or industrial refineries.

entries.applicability_note: Execution track-record check for every bidder.
entries.demo_note: Demo evidence carries threshold + 15 percentage points.
entries.description: Satisfactory completion of at least one single contract of 40% or more of the estimated tender value.
entries.requirement_name: Past Contract Performance (Single Order ≥ 40% of Estimate)

entries.applicability_note: Applies to goods/supply tenders where OEM authorization is required. Not applicable to pure works tenders.
entries.demo_note: Boolean extraction: affirmative values only (negation-safe since the 2026-10-04 audit fix).
entries.description: Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) signed by the OEM's authorized signatory, valid for this tender.

entries.applicability_note: PPP-MII applies to goods tenders. Demo default is NON-mandatory so the Apex partial-compliance scenario is preserved.
entries.demo_note: Apex deliberately declares 35% local content on this non-mandatory requirement: a real FAIL that cannot sink the bid.
entries.description: Self-certification or CA certificate indicating minimum 50% local value addition under the PPP-MII order.
entries.requirement_name: Make in India (MII) Local Content Declaration

entries.applicability_note: MSE/NSIC-registered bidders may claim EMD exemption; mark non-mandatory when the exemption applies.
entries.demo_note: Demo evidence matches the threshold exactly (a deposit, not a capacity metric).
entries.description: EMD via bank guarantee or online payment receipt for the stipulated amount, in favour of the tendering authority.

entries.applicability_note: Integrity check for every bidder.
entries.demo_note: Never fabricates a clean chit: a missing BLACKLIST check evaluates to REVIEW_REQUIRED. PrimeTech's mock blacklist record produces the intended FAIL.
entries.description: Bidder is not debarred or blacklisted by any government authority; declaration cross-checked against the debarment registry.

rule_config.expression: ('REVIEW_REQUIRED' if ctx.get('verification', {}).get('BLACKLIST') is None else ('FAIL' if ctx['verification']['BLACKLIST'].get('data', {}).get('blacklisted', False) else 'PASS'))

entries.applicability_note: Enable for technically intensive tenders. Satisfied by the technical bid dossier; otherwise an unclassified technical document (OTHER) also satisfies.
entries.demo_note: 'Any one of' semantics: BID_DOSSIER or any unclassified document satisfies.
entries.description: Bidder's technical bid complies with the tender's technical specifications (datasheets, compliance statement).

entries.applicability_note: Applicable for services/works tenders involving deployed manpower.
entries.demo_note: Demo evidence is generated only for profiles carrying an epfo_code (Apex, PrimeTech).
entries.description: Active Employees' Provident Fund Organisation registration for establishments deploying manpower.

entries.applicability_note: Applicable for services/works tenders involving deployed manpower.
entries.demo_note: No demo profile carries an esic_code, so enabling this yields REVIEW_REQUIRED until evidence exists.
entries.description: Active Employee State Insurance Corporation registration for establishments deploying manpower.

entries.applicability_note: Officer's discretion; relevant only when startup benefits apply.
entries.demo_note: Demo evidence is generated only for the Apex profile.
entries.description: Valid DPIIT Startup India recognition certificate, where startup benefits are claimed.

entries.applicability_note: Only when NSIC-registered MSE participation is expected. NOTE: the NSIC mock adapter is registered but not yet wired to an extractor or fixtures — enabling this requirement will honestly report REVIEW_REQUIRED until then.
entries.demo_note: Adapter registered but unreachable: no extractor emits nsic_number and the fixture store is empty.
entries.description: Valid NSIC Single Point Registration for MSEs (EMD exemption / tender set purchase benefits).

entries.applicability_note: Legacy consolidated-dossier check. 'Any one of' semantics: any single listed document type satisfies.
entries.demo_note: Kept for backward compatibility with tenders created by the legacy wizard template.
entries.description: Complete signed technical packet and statutory annexures submitted as one consolidated dossier.
Bidder must furnish the Income Tax Return for financial year 2023–24. The extracted financial year must match the required year.
entries.applicability_note: Applies to every tender of the listed types.
entries.demo_note: Document-backed: the ITR PDF is generated per scenario; the FY mismatch scenario fails this rule.

entries.description: Bidder should hold an active MCA21-registered company (CIN). Verified against the mock MCA21 registry; the certificate PDF is supporting evidence.
entries.applicability_note: Applies to every tender of the listed types.
entries.demo_note: Registry-backed with a generated certificate PDF. Mock MCA21 fixtures are written per scenario.

entries.description: Bidder must meet the minimum average annual turnover evidenced by the audited balance sheet for FY 2023–24.
entries.applicability_note: Applies to every tender of the listed types.
entries.demo_note: Turnover shortfall scenario generates a below-threshold balance sheet.

entries.description: Bidder must furnish a work experience/completion certificate for relevant prior work.
entries.applicability_note: Applies to every tender of the listed types.
entries.demo_note: Experience-conflict scenario pairs the certificate with a contradictory work order.

entries.description: Bidder should hold a valid (unexpired) ISO 9001 certificate.
entries.applicability_note: Applies when the tender requires quality certification.
entries.demo_note: Expired-ISO scenario generates a lapsed validity date; number-mismatch scenario contradicts the fixture.

entries.description: Bidder must deposit the earnest money deposit; the receipt amount must meet the tender requirement.
entries.applicability_note: Applies unless the bidder is exempt (MSE/Startup).
entries.demo_note: Wrong-amount scenario generates a short receipt; wrong-beneficiary is visible in extracted fields.

applicability.CONDITIONAL: Applies only when the tender's facts trigger it (tender type, manpower, MSE benefit claim, EMD exemption, ...).
applicability.OPTIONAL: At the officer's discretion; off by default.
applicability.REQUIRED: Applies to every tender of the listed types.

meta.description: Single authoritative source of tender requirement templates for the Create Tender wizard and the TenderWizard dialog. Every entry's rule_config uses the exact schema consumed by the backend deterministic rules engine (backend/app/engines/rules_engine.py). backend/tests/test_requirement_catalogue.py validates this file against the engine — edit entries there, not in the UI components.
meta.name: BIDWISE requirement catalogue
meta.weight_note: Entries with in_default_template=true form the demo default template; their default_weight values MUST total exactly 100. The default template covers the 10 document types (Udyam, GST, PAN, ITR 2023-24, MCA21, Balance Sheet 2024, Work Experience, ISO 9001, EMD, EPFO). These are illustrative demonstration defaults, not official GeM/CPCL-prescribed weights.
